summary_1line: Rama in exile respectfully greets his mothers and guru as the queens mourn his hardships and Dasaratha’s death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama rises from the hermitage seat and bows to touch the feet of his grieving mothers as they gather around him in the forest.
Queen Kausalya gazes sorrowfully at the simple funeral offering of a flour ball placed on the ground for King Dasaratha.
Kausalya embraces the frail Sita in the forest hermitage while tears fill the eyes of the surrounding queens.
